overview: Over five intense days, 120 Hours Behind Bars delivers an unfiltered look inside America's toughest jails -- where officers are outnumbered, cellblocks are overcrowded, and violence erupts without warning.
After 25 years of silent devotion, a man finally approaches the woman he has always loved, triggering a chain of revelations tied to a dark incident from their past.
Travel back to 1990s Berlin and discover the story of a family caught between bureaucracy, politics, and social exclusion, determined to build a new life in Germany.
The story of September 11 through the eyes of survivors who experienced life-or-death moments with strangers that day and now want to meet again.
An intimate, raw portrait of Manchester City FC across two era-defining seasons. With unprecedented access, the film follows their worst run in decades and fightback to glory.

A seemingly ordinary working mother secretly lives as a legendary sniper who delivers justice where the law fails. After returning from a three-year hiatus, she must balance protecting her family with eliminating dangerous criminals, all while a determined journalist and a relentless detective close in on her hidden identity.
Follow "A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms" from the page to the screen in this fascinating and comprehensive look at how HBO's newest series in the Game of Thrones universe was brought to life.

A century before the events of Game of Thrones, two unlikely heroes wandered Westeros: a young, naive but courageous knight, Ser Duncan the Tall, and his diminutive squire, Egg. Set in an age when the Targaryen line still holds the Iron Throne and the last dragon has not yet passed from living memory, great destinies, powerful foes, and dangerous exploits await these improbable and incomparable friends.
A realistic, emotionally resonant romance about a couple in their tenth year together whose comfortable relationship is tested by unexpected feelings.

Amidst war and chaos, Han Yunling, a young female doctor, emerges to save lives while uncovering secrets of her tragic past. With the help of General Xiao Chi, their bond deepens as she tries to clear her family’s name and bring peace to the nation.
Bound by an unexpected marriage, Hataya and Ramil are outcasts in their families — but that won't deter them from saving their kin to prove their worth.

In a world where love is rarely simple, two people find themselves drawn to each other despite the expectations and struggles surrounding them. As family ties, personal choices, and difficult circumstances test their bond, they must decide how far they are willing to go to protect what they feel.

After years away from her family, Gu Jinzhao returns home and begins a remarkable transformation, from a carefree young woman into a poised and influential noble lady. As questions of marriage arise, she refuses to follow tradition and holds firmly to her own beliefs about love. But when multiple men enter her life, each offering a different future, who will Gu Jinzhao choose?
A pair of lookalikes, one a former French aristocrat and the other an alcoholic English lawyer, fall in love with the same woman amidst the turmoil of the French Revolution.

The drama tells the story of Li Xiaoxi, a cautious and serious woman when it comes to love, who unexpectedly meets Xiaobei. Their chance encounter blossoms into a romantic relationship. Xiaobei’s loyalty and unwavering support give Li Xiaoxi the strength to gradually overcome her insecurities about love. In turn, with Li Xiaoxi’s companionship and acceptance, Xiaobei heals from past emotional wounds and learns to let go and cherish the present. As they navigate their relationship, facing challenges together, both grow and ultimately find a sincere and lasting love.
High schooler Yeo Eui-ju secretly writes web novels by night. When four charming new teachers arrive, they inspire her stories and shake up her school.

The long-standing peace of a conservative small town is shattered by the appearance of an online novel "Abyss." Many plot points bear a striking resemblance to a cold case from years ago that has never been made public. Li Cheng, a passionate and righteous rookie police officer, engages in a series of high-stakes battles of wits with various suspects. He unravels the mystery, revealing the truth buried beneath heartbreaking kinships and friendships.

Shen Jialan, once a nobleman's granddaughter, falls from grace after her family is falsely accused of treason. Abandoned by her fiancé Lin Jinqi, she is forced to assume a servant's identity in his household. Despite hardships, she refuses to bow to fate. With resilience and wit, she rises above class barriers, wins Lin Jinqi's heart, earns the family's respect, and ultimately clears her family's name.

England, 1925. At a lavish country house party, a practical joke appears to have gone horribly, murderously wrong. It will be up to the unlikeliest of sleuths—the fizzingly inquisitive Lady Eileen 'Bundle' Brent—to unravel a chilling plot that will change her life, cracking wide open the country house mystery.
Bound by a deity's pact, Han Chieh fights demons on Earth. When he uncovers an old enemy's plan for a second invasion, he must fight to save humanity.
When an unassuming dad's daughter goes missing, he dusts off his old black-ops skills to track her down — only to attract the wrong kind of attention.

A Saudi anthology series from the creators of the beloved AlKhallat+ universe, now streaming on Netflix. Four standalone stories drop ordinary underdogs — an anxious teen, a clueless security guard, a desperate filmmaker, and a tongue-tied poet — into absurdly chaotic desert situations. Sharp satire, dry humour, and authentic Saudi cultural identity make each episode a wildly entertaining ride.

Six idols – Lee Teuk and Shin Dong of Super Junior, Kim Yo Han of WEi, Johnny and Ji Sung of NCT, and soloist DAWN – are all set to spend a week together in Egypt. Of course, there's a twist involved: as they travel, they must complete a series of missions that will affect their future plans. The winners will become "princes," receiving luxury accommodations, meals and other perks, while the losers become “beggars,” continuing their journey under limited conditions. Each mission becomes a battle to decide who will travel in comfort and style, and who will have to tough it out.
Two roommates join a bachelorette road trip, where unspoken feelings ignite and shake up their entire friend group.
A psychological thriller anthology series focusing on a different hostage case every season.
Eccentric, monochromatic crewmates of a ship transporting junk across the galaxy must root out an Impostor in their midst before they fall victim to its villainous designs.

Healer A Zhao, a descendant of a goddess from the Wuyue Clan, falls in love with Ying Du, the ruler of the Puluo Kingdom, only to witness him massacre her clan and become bound to him across three lifetimes by a time-reversing bracelet. As A Zhao uncovers the truth and challenges heavenly law, she fights to break their cursed fate and reclaim their love.

Anna Pigeon flees city life for the solitude of America's stunning national parks following a devastating loss; while Anna tries to outrun her demons, her focus turns to solving crimes that have taken place within national park grounds.

In the early days of the Republic of China, a mysterious murder at sea draws Zhang Haiyan and his partner into an investigation that quickly spirals into a dangerous conspiracy. What begins as a search for truth aboard the massive ship Nan'an becomes a fight for survival in a world of intrigue and betrayal.
After dying 33 times while trying to win a crown prince's love, a palace maid learns that her fate is tied to a rival prince and joins forces with him to break the cycle.

The general's daughter, Chu Zhao, refuses to accept her fate as nothing more than a pawn to be sacrificed in Xiao Xun's rise to power. Taking matters into her own hands, she fights her way out with the help of Xie Yanlai, protecting the emperor's grandson as he makes his way to the emperor's presence. Through a tense standoff in the imperial court, she helps the young prince secure the throne, cutting off Xiao Xun's path to power. But with a new emperor comes new crises. The realm is torn by internal strife and foreign threats. Working alongside Xie Yanlai, Chu Zhao navigates the treacherous currents of the court, leads troops into battle, and ultimately rewrites her own destiny, sparing the people of the State of Chu from the ravages of war.

In a world shattered by a devastating cataclysm, a young Earthbender discovers she's the new Avatar after Korra. But in this dangerous era, that title marks her as humanity's destroyer, not its savior. Hunted by both human and spirit enemies, she and her long-lost twin must uncover their mysterious origins and save the Seven Havens before civilization's last strongholds collapse.

During World War II, photographer Chen Kailai unexpectedly becomes involved in an underground resistance mission to stop the Japanese army’s secret biological experiment. Taking up his fallen mentor’s codename, he joins fellow spies in a perilous fight to expose the enemy’s crimes and prevent a viral catastrophe.
Two people stuck in their lives become haenyeo divers, finding healing and new meaning in the sea as they confront their pasts and fears together.
Bake Your Dream is a global pastry competition where elite and rising pastry chefs face off in intense challenges, blending technique, creativity, and passion to claim the ultimate title.

Following the death of their mother, their pillar of strength and their anchor, eleven siblings aged 7 to 23 try to stay united in the face of adversity. But for some of them, drug trafficking seems to be the only way to survive. A decision far from being unanimously accepted, and one that severely tests the strength of their family bonds.

Bapa Mentuaku Mafia follows Takdir, a principled young Islamic teacher whose peaceful life is disrupted when mafia boss Zack kidnaps him and forces him to marry his daughter, Melissa. Thrust into a dangerous world of crime, family secrets and complicated relationships, Takdir struggles to uphold his faith while attempting to reform his new family and transform their illegal business.

Is our fate predetermined? And can anyone truly read it? A groundbreaking competition dares to find out. Korea's top 49 top Fate Readers—masters of shamanism, saju, tarot, and face reading—put their pride on the line. Only those who can genuinely read fate will survive. Who will be the winner?
A bride is poisoned during her wedding reception, forcing the groom and a photographer to investigate the guests as dark secrets and hypocrisies among the bride's friends and family are revealed.
When a mysterious sea creature terrorizes a small Newfoundland town, a hard-bitten fisherman and his family fight to protect their close-knit community.

Former detective Dennis Crown has swapped the chaos of the UK for a quieter life running a bar in Benidorm. But when tourists start turning up dead, he's reluctantly drawn back into detective work-egged on by his barmaid Rosa, a crime drama superfan. With Dennis's real-world experience and Rosa's encyclopaedic TV knowledge, each episode sees the duo tackling a new murder in paradise, whilst trying to remain on the right side of the local Spanish cops.
Hungry for a new heist, Berlin summons the gang to Seville and turns an ambitious duke into the victim of his own plan: to steal a da Vinci masterpiece.

Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they’ve got.

Two modern best friends find themselves inside a household-intrigue novel as sisters-in-law destined for tragic deaths. As they outwit deadly schemes and find love with two brothers from the Shen family, they uncover an old injustice and a royal conspiracy that could determine their family's fate.

Minjae, a former swimmer, lost a leg to illness. Now a PhD student, he's built a quiet, controlled life, until Yujin, a master's student starting over after losing her way, throws it off balance. In a robotics lab, their romance turns fiery, bittersweet, and tender.
Pearadise promised safety and a utopia for plus‑size women. The sisterhood turns dark as allegations of assault and coercion spread among the women.
Blackmailed into working for some very dangerous people, two deeply incapable siblings become the most disorganized duo in organized crime.

Four-part docuseries that explores the complex relationship between Black Americans and Jewish Americans - forged in shared struggle, tested by division, and representing a uniquely American experience.
While searching for a legendary coral reef near a cursed island, a marine biologist uncovers a web of conspiracies, local legends, and hidden crimes that threaten both his mission and his life.

A detective infiltrates a notorious prison to investigate disappearances while a retired soldier enters to rescue a mother and daughter, forcing the two enemies to work together against a criminal conspiracy.
In a society shaped by the internet and media, a lawyer fights to clear the names of those wrongly accused by exposing the truth behind carefully crafted lies.
Cast members of "Never-Ending Summer" reunite for a two-day variety show experience, taking part in games and compatibility tests to determine the best acting duo.
Following the brutal murder of two police officers, a tenacious detective reluctantly joins forces with his estranged ex-cop father to catch the killer.
In the world of crime and injustice, dangerous missions force those on opposite sides of the law to choose between protecting family and doing their duty.
A former medical school dropout claiming to be able to cure terminal illnesses is sentenced to death for the murder of 17 people. Is he a monstrous killer, or a savior holding the cure for humanity?

In a town where strict rules shape students into their “best selves,” a hidden Bloodfruit Tree bears crimson fruit. A mysterious boy in black delivers these fruits only to those who truly “need” them. Once received, they awaken long-suppressed desires—gently unraveling the heart, and quietly leading the town toward irreversible collapse.
A heartwarming tale follows three sisters from Kashgar's ancient city as they navigate love, family bonds, and life's storms together, rebuilding their lives with resilience and hope.

Once a flight attendant, Ruan Sixian pursues her piloting dream through flight school, later clashing and reconciling with aviation executive Fu Mingyu in a high-stakes race for industry innovation and mutual professional redemption.

The sole survivor of a bloodshed, Gu Qingzhi awakens under a new identity — Shen Xihe, the Princess of the Northwest. Once a proud and spirited rose of the frontier, she has now transformed into a cold, calculating figure, determined to seize control of her destiny and dominate the game of power. Crown Prince Xiao Huayong, frail in body but razor-sharp in mind, sees through the treacherous currents of the court. As their fates intertwine, they grow closer, joining forces to command the winds of destiny.

When top movie stars meet senior citizens, a truly heartwarming chemistry is about to unfold! "Bonjour Bakery" sets its scene in a tranquil rural village, creating Korea's first cafe exclusively for the elderly. Here, more than just desserts are sold; stories are shared. A super-warm "service team" composed of Kim Hee-ae and Kim Seon-ho heals each senior with gentle conversations and kind smiles; in the kitchen, "all-around chef" Cha Seung-won and Lee Ki-taek transform local ingredients into exquisite works of art. Watch as these celebrities accompany seniors as they reminisce about their lives, spreading warmth through the aroma of bread.

After being murdered at her own wedding by those closest to her, a top influencer becomes trapped in an endless time loop. With each resurrection, she uncovers more of the conspiracy and joins forces with a doctor who remembers the loops to prevent the tragedy before it happens.

In 1990s Qinghai’s Maji County, rampant poaching plunged the region into poverty. Deputy County Head Dorje’s mountain patrol team shifted from mineral exploration to protecting antelopes. Bai Ju, a fearless female officer raised by a Tibetan doctor, grew into a leader fighting for a nature reserve with her comrades and journalist lover, only to face Dorje’s mysterious disappearance. Decades later, as coal mining threatens the eco-balance again, Bai Ju reunites with allies to solve the cold case and uphold the legacy of safeguarding the Tibetan Plateau’s untouched beauty.

Zhang Yi'ang, a veteran detective, is sent to Sanjiangkou to investigate a case but soon finds himself caught in a web of crime and corruption. While pursuing a powerful criminal network, he unexpectedly receives help from a group of bungling thieves, who inadvertently aid his mission to unravel the truth behind a murder.
Seo Mi-rae is worn out by work. Love? It's the last thing on her mind. But a virtual dating service sparks feelings — and maybe a real shot at romance.

After devoting himself entirely to enlightenment and neglecting his immortal consort, Zhao Dong is betrayed and enters a tribulation filled with regret. Reborn in the body of a rural thug who shares his name, he experiences mortal life firsthand and comes to understand the importance of balance.
In 1970, the Brazilian national team took the field with big dreams and an even bigger challenge: to become the first three-time world champions.

When executive Seong Tae-hun is abruptly reassigned to the remote village of Yeonri‑ri, his family is thrown into rural chaos. Mi-ryeo struggles with farm life, Ji-cheon begins to rethink his future, and the wary village chief keeps his distance. As homesickness grows and tensions rise, the family must decide whether to endure—or find their way back home.

After graduating college, the group return to Calabasas for “a summer they’ll never forget”. Back home and living in their parents’ hillside mansions, they’ll be faced with the daunting reality of confronting unresolved drama while trying to define what’s next for their lives and relationships. Four years may have put distance between them, but new flames, old feuds, and unexpected secrets don’t stay hidden forever behind the gates of LA’s most envied zip code.
The emotions of a celebrity and her interpreter get lost in translation as they travel the world filming a TV show. Will love find its own language?

Debbie Fenton is a granny, lawn bowler, tinpot dictator - who will stop at nothing to make sure her family's protected. Unfortunately, most of the time the person they really need protecting from is her. When her hermit-like husband William unexpectedly dies, she makes an outlandish decision that will put the family under more pressure than ever before.
When convicted murderer Max Cady is released from prison, he begins infiltrating the family of the married attorneys who helped put him behind bars.

The nation always comes first. For Captain Isfandyar, patriotism was more than just a word. It was a way of life. He faced every challenge with courage, every threat with determination, and every sacrifice with pride. His journey serves as a powerful reminder of what it truly means to serve the nation.

After her father's sudden, untimely death thrusts her into the unforgiving ecosystem of public high school, Carrie is forced to navigate a viral bullying scandal that tears through her community, the relentless pressure and casual cruelty of the social‑media age, and the awakening of mysterious telekinetic powers that rise alongside her adolescence.

A 17-year-old girl is found burned and dismembered in an empty lot in a middle-class neighborhood of Santiago, Chile. Due to police negligence, the crime goes unpunished until thirty years later, when the family manages to piece together the murder puzzle, revealing a forbidden relationship and a cruel truth.

An Argentine dramatic television miniseries co-produced by TNT and FLOW. It follows the life of a nun who, after fifteen years, manages to escape from a cloistered convent where she was a victim of psychological abuse and held against her will. Starring Carolina Kopelioff, Lorena Vega, Rita Cortese, and Julieta Zylberberg.

When by-the-book FBI Special Agent Bill Goodman is loaned out to a clandestine CIA/FBI task force, he finds himself teamed up with secretive and roguish CIA case officer Colin Glass. Together they work covert operations in New York, uncovering international plots, terrorist cells, and geopolitical secrets.

Berlin — a city-state on the brink. While a privileged few live beneath a climate-controlled dome, those outside struggle to survive in a world ravaged by heat, corruption, and crime. After years apart, sisters Bea and Phoebe are reunited and uncover a dark secret: Vampires are determined to seize political power — and blood has become the city's new currency.

After his family is massacred, Lian Ye teams up with police official Li Mingyuan and dance hall owner Chen Dieyi to investigate the tragedy. Their investigation exposes a Japanese espionage conspiracy threatening the city, forcing them to fight the invaders and defend their homeland.

An ambitious prosecutor rises through Korea’s elite by marrying a famous actress, only to be pulled into a ruthless power cartel where hidden informants, corporate heirs, and political players collide in a brutal struggle for survival and control.

Pits America’s buzziest mixologists against each other in a lively, high-stakes competition with $10,000 on the line in every episode. Each installment showcases a fast, fiery battle of skill, creativity, humor, and flair. From playful flavor combinations to eye-catching technique, the focus is on having a good time, taking risks, and serving up drinks with personality. Each shake, stir, and splash could be the winning touch or the one that sends them home. It’s a cocktail competition where the vibes are high, the drinks are strong, and the bragging rights are everything.

A docuseries examining one of Mexico's most controversial political events: the 1994 assassination of presidential candidate Luis Donaldo Colosio. It explores the investigation, contradictions, and unanswered questions surrounding the case.
A coven protects their magic school from a dark fate.
Rapper Toni returns to his hometown for his mother's funeral and suddenly finds himself juggling career dreams and surprise fatherhood to a teenage son.
After a family scandal, teen rower Teagan Tao moves to a small town and joins an elite prep school's all-boys crew, sparking rivalry and attraction.

Single mother Pam Voorhees has been unable to shake her grief after her young, sickly son Jason tragically drowned in the town lake almost a year before. When two strangers arrive at Pam's door digging into her past, a disturbing chain of events is set into motion, leaving the townspeople of Crystal Lake wondering: just who is Pam Voorhees?
A scrappy lawyer takes on a powerful tech giant in a high-stakes legal battle, navigating the cutthroat world of Silicon Valley while fighting for justice and the little guy's rights.

Actress Kim Tae-ri, a first-time teacher, starts a theatre club at a rural school on the verge of closure. Together with the students, she builds a unique after-school theatre club, capturing real, unscripted lessons and growth. As the stage comes to life, small changes begin to ripple beyond the classroom.

After the murder of a police chief’s son, a covert, off-the-books task force is assembled to infiltrate Philadelphia’s most dangerous crime families, but as the investigation deepens, the line between cop and criminal disappears, and no one walks away clean.

Haunted by the guilt of her past and dealing with the demons of her present, a newly-appointed DCP, Rita Ferreira, must embark on an investigation of a series of murders that puts her on a collision course with a cold-blooded serial killer.
Billy, a former cameraman, encounters Dani on a Sydney Harbour ferry as their different worlds intersect.
After their sister Ruthie blows up her perfect life, Andrew and Eunice show her the fun in being flawed as she helps them adult.

Years after moving to the US, Alys returns home as a successful pastry chef while building a life with Tripp. But seeing Drake again revives old feelings and unresolved heartbreak, pulling the three into an emotional journey of love, sacrifice, and second chances.

After a family emergency, Qing Ye returned to her hometown in her senior year of high school. Finding it difficult to adjust after spending most of her life in a bustling city, Qing Ye vows to leave as soon as she gets a chance. But when she meets Xing Wu, a local teen who's struggling with school, she resolves to help him graduate. Gradually, Xing Wu and Qing Ye grow closer to each other, despite their different personalities and priorities in life. Upon graduating high school, Qing Ye moves away for university, but ends up returning years later – and so does Xing Wu, who still has feelings for Qing Ye. Will this second chance give them a chance to finally realize their feelings for each other?
A brutal chase for survival across a vast battlefield where no one can be trusted and only the last one standing wins.
After losing her fiancé, a grieving woman tracks down the recipients of his donated organs, leading to unexpected connections and emotional revelations.
Yu Song enters the Song family as an assistant to seek justice for her father. With Song Cheng's trust and the driver's help, she gathers evidence to expose the family's crimes.
What happened to Mica Miller? This documentary series retraces her promising life, toxic marriage and the mysterious circumstances of her death.
When her father's worsening dementia makes him a prime suspect in a murder case, a small-town school teacher races to uncover the truth amid dark rumors.
Every Holi in Devtali, a death is blamed on the mythical demon, Shankasur. Inspector Vishwas investigates the latest death, only to uncover an unsettling truth about the alleged divine punishment.
In the first-ever directorial survival show, short-form drama directors compete to prove they have what it takes to capture audiences' attention.
An actress and her twin brother slip through time – and swap bodies – to save their friend's life.

In South Korea, military service is mandatory for all men. But a select few—like privileged medical students—can serve as public health doctors instead. This is the story of those privileged few. Do Ji-ui, a plastic surgeon, is assigned to Pyeondong-do, an isolated island no one wants to go to. From the very first day, ominous signs begin to appear. Can he survive a full year on this hellish island and make it out alive—or will the island break him before he can hold the line?
Forensic pathologist Qin Ming investigates a woman's brutal murder and uncovers a series of connected cases tied to a mysterious avenger, a secret room, and a decade-old revenge plot.
A medical thriller melodrama depicting the events that unfold between a genius doctor and the woman he loves after a chance accident.
After facing major setbacks in his career, Zhou Dongbei returns to Northeast China determined to rebuild his life, protect his family’s legacy, and fight his way back to success.
On the surface, they're wives, mothers, and suburban neighbors, but that's only half the story. Behind closed doors, these six St. Louis women secretly make a living creating spicy content.

Years ago, journalist Shen Leshui recorded the lives of workers at the Old La City Brewery. Now she returns to La City, picks up her camera again, and explores corners forgotten by time. Cao Jun, Tu Chunyan, Qian Yichuan, Cheng Youtian... These people, once the subjects of her lens, experience the rise and fall of fate in the torrent of time. Their stories are like riddles sealed by time. Moving between the past and the present, Shen Leshui uncovers these chapters of the past buried by time.

After being set up by her company, 36-year-old executive Xia Xiaolan wakes up as her 18-year-old self in a poor village. Determined to change her fate, she pursues education while building a business empire from nothing. Along the way, she finds love, support, and a renewed sense of purpose, proving that courage and determination lead to true success.
A fallen music producer hits rock bottom and finds redemption by training a struggling boy band, navigating fierce K-POP competition and forging unbreakable bonds along the way.

Two high school classmates bond over a shared love of filmmaking, turning a deep friendship into first love before an unexpected separation tears them apart. Years later, they reunite with their lives completely transformed—she’s lost her passion, while he’s become a celebrated director. Determined to reignite her dreams, he must first confront the hurt he left behind.
After criminals kidnap her baby, overwhelmed new mom Ruyi Zhang joins an unlikely crew of gangsters, ghosts and deities for a frantic rescue mission.
A love triangle among three adults experiencing middle-age malaise leads to one of them ending up dead.

After clinching a major win in a high stakes divorce case, ambitious lawyer and Lion Mum, Durrani (Nurul Aini) treads into the unpredictable world of family law. She soon learns that it's an entirely different battlefield - one where love, loss and conflict blur the lines between right and wrong, and every case tests not just her skill, but her heart.

Rip Wheeler and Beth Dutton gamble everything on a new life in South Texas, but the promise of building a future far from the ghosts of Yellowstone quickly collides with brutal new realities and a rival ranch that will stop at nothing to protect its empire.
Alix Earle, Gen Z's ultimate "It" girl, gets real in this unscripted, unfiltered series that goes behind the scenes of her life and family.
In the early 1900s, a fiercely independent woman drives a rift between two brothers, igniting a saga that unfolds across two generations.

During a brutal war, cook Meng Wanfu is mistaken for a fugitive general and steps in to protect the general’s family, while the real General Zhang Yunkui, feeling powerless, joins the guerrilla fighters; together, their courage and loyalty help carry their nation through its darkest hour.
After an unprecedented attack on his unit, a high-ranking officer set to leave the field leads a perilous mission that forces him to confront his past.

Before Elle Woods was a fish-out-of-water at Harvard, we meet her in 1995 in the tumultuous waters of high school where she encounters tricky friendships, forbidden romance, and questionable fashion choices. In this unexpected chapter of her adolescence, we learn about the experiences that shaped Elle into the iconic young woman we've come to know and love.
Follow first-person confessional accounts of medical emergencies from the people who survived them.

Charles and Liz are a charming, married 500-year-old vampire couple whose relationship has survived centuries because, as vampires, divorce isn’t exactly an option. Together, they navigate modern society and their daughter dating a human.
Six summers to fall in love. One moment to fall apart. A week to get it right. A fun, sweeping, romantic story that asks the question, what if your first love actually was your soulmate?

Psychic Wu Yue joins forces with a policewoman, a forensic examiner, and a sketch artist to investigate a string of shocking cases, from fake resurrections to serial murders. As their all-female team digs deeper, Wu Yue crosses paths with wealthy heir Ji Wenxuan, whose carefully hidden secret draws them into a dangerous family conspiracy. With the truth slowly surfacing, the women must confront not only cunning killers, but the darker side of human desire and revenge itself.
With her extraordinary memory and unique perspective, Minami takes on challenges in and out of the courtroom as a rookie lawyer on the autism spectrum.

When Huo Ming loses his memory in an accident, a hidden AI chip awakens superhuman abilities within him. Caught in Lin Yun’s corporate battle, he must confront hidden truths, protect those he cares about, and find love, all while redefining who he really is.

Judged as a mistress’s daughter, a young woman fights a stigma she never chose. Meanwhile, another woman’s life stands still after her husband's betrayal. Bound together by the death of the man who tore their lives apart, these two apparent enemies are forced to confront one another under one roof. As families scarred by hatred and heartbreak collide, old wounds resurface. Facing years of prejudice, they set out to reclaim their lives and transform their bitter fate into an unexpected family bond.

After traveling back to ancient times, modern office worker Lu Yunluo finds herself as a neglected imperial consort in the Cold Palace. When she meets the newly enthroned Emperor Ji Wujue, she uses her knowledge of medicine and agriculture to transform her circumstances and their lives.

Lin Moqing assumes a false identity to manipulate and train Lan Hewei as part of a calculated plan against his powerful family. But as deception, shifting alliances, and hidden motives collide, Lan Hewei proves far more formidable than he expected. What begins as a strategic game of control gradually evolves into a tense and unpredictable relationship, where rivalry and attraction blur—and neither can fully anticipate who will come out on top.
A time-traveling ballerina and a troubled student are trapped in a deadly cycle of love and death, forcing them to find the killer before fate repeats itself.

To break a powerful curse and save his clan, Lu Qianqiao is reborn as a human and secretly marries Xin Mei, a gifted cultivator with a fated curse. What starts as a mission of survival soon entangles them in betrayal, memory loss, and growing affection as they face deadly trials and uncover their intertwined destinies.

Three seemingly ordinary but deadly uncles, whose fate sets them in motion again. It depicts the everyday lives of three middle-aged men, who have lived 50% of their lives, and the realistic comedy of these uncles who are even sadder because they were successful in their past.
A disgraced, formerly incarcerated boxing champion returns to London to seek vengeance against the crime syndicate he thinks betrayed him.
A romantic comedy about Joo In-ah, a charismatic audit department head with a secret, and Noh Ki-joon, the department's ace who is suddenly demoted to deal with the company's scandals.

The Table: K-Chef 2026 brings together Korea's top chefs to compete for the title of the country's best chef. Mysterious world-renowned chef Chris K., also known as Kang Han, Song-yi, who is fighting to save her restaurant, perfectionist star chef Woo-jin, and chefs with stories of their own face off in a fierce culinary battle. More than a competition, they find comfort in food and one another.
A former ice dancer returns to the rink with an exciting new partner while holding onto feelings for her old one — her first love.

Chou Lu-yung sets out to uncover the truth behind his father's death while managing the family restaurant, "Chin Lai Hao." He faces life’s challenges with his close friends and vows to seek justice for his father.

Carol Crottie grows suspicious when her husband Robert, suffering from dementia, refuses to leave their home. She begins to question what really happened to his first wife Joan, who vanished with his brother two decades earlier.

In the early years of China's reform and opening-up, five law school graduates—Chen Yizhong, Yu Gaoyuan, Lu Zeming, Xia Yingjie, and Zhang Lihui—embarked on diverse careers within the judicial system.
When two young pianists from completely different worlds meet at an elite music high school, the melodies of their lives become intimately intertwined.

FBI agent Alice Black is on the hunt for a mysterious and calculating female serial killer. Both walk their own paths toward justice, and as their lives start to intertwine, the line between right and wrong begins to blur.

Veteran sportscaster Lindsay Czarniak explores the deadly intersection of sports and crime through six murder investigations involving athletes. Each episode blends a gripping whodunit with the culture surrounding the game.
An inside look at Norway's criminal landscape since the 1980s -- as told by those who ruled the streets and lived to share their stories.

The GBRB crew returns for a new challenge as Lee Kwang Soo, Kim Woo Bin, and Doh Kyung Soo swap city life for the ranch. Spending several days alongside experienced ranchers, the trio learns the essentials of raising dairy cows and horses while experiencing the hard work and philosophy behind livestock farming. From feeding animals to tackling demanding daily tasks, the three celebrities approach every mission with determination, humor, and plenty of mishaps. Their playful chemistry and growing bond with the animals create both hilarious and heartwarming moments. Blending comedy, friendship, and the charm of rural life, the show offers a refreshing look at ranch life and the unexpected rewards of working together in nature.

In the volatile world of martial arts, the cunning young master Mu Qingyan meets the easygoing heroine Cai Zhao, sparking an intense and complex romance. Together, they confront hidden truths and rivalries within the martial world, navigating twists, betrayals, and strategic battles. Their journey paints a vibrant portrait of loyalty, love, and the fierce spirit of heroism.
A genius girl and her childhood sweetheart navigate life's challenges from campus to marriage in this heartwarming coming-of-age story filled with wit, warmth and youthful passion.
In a new universe, the mysterious Nanno poses as a transfer student, exposing cruelty by turning power, guilt and desire against those who abuse them.

Follow the story of twin sisters Lily and Abby, whose lives are shattered when Lily is abducted from their quiet rural English town by beloved local teacher Rick Hansen. After years of abuse in captivity, Lily escapes - only to discover that freedom brings its own challenges.
Delves into competitive ice dance's intense world, where deep partnerships, total dedication, and raw emotions merge in the pursuit of Olympic gold.

Shen Yaochu is forced into a marriage with General Li Jingchuan, believed to be dead, only to discover he’s alive. After her mother’s tragic death, Shen Yaochu and Li Jingchuan join forces to unravel conspiracies and hidden plots within the Shen family, discovering trust and love along the way.

Senior Sergeant Arnold Kipps is having the worst day of his life. His ex-partner returns to Nompton to shut down his police station, just as an ancient evil is awakened by the Gnome Queen who unleashes a hellish horde, plunging the town into chaos.

Gold Wars Downunder follows three hardcore mining teams as they battle it out on the one patch of gold-rich-land to see who can unearth the biggest nuggets and the most gold in an epic made-for-television gold hunting season. The sale of gold is an important source of income for hundreds of thousands of Australians, including the men and women willing to risk it all, as they venture into some of the most dangerous and inhospitable territory on the planet - hoping to strike it rich.

Legendary warriors Ax Battler, Tyris Flare, and Gilius Thunderhead reunite to save Yuria from the evil giant Death Adder, who just won't seem to stay dead. Their quest is complicated by Hampton Squib, an inexperienced and wildly underprepared adventurer whose dream of heroism far exceeds his abilities. Forced to work together despite their flaws, they must find a way to stop Death Adder once and for all.

A young woman working as an airport security agent accidentally comes into possession of a smuggling ring’s gold bars. Caught in a chaotic whirlwind of greed and betrayal among various parties vying for the gold, she becomes consumed by the desire to claim it all for herself.

The series Gomorrah - The Origins explores Pietro Savastano's youth in the 1970s, in a Naples undergoing a transformation, poverty-stricken and plagued by cigarette smuggling. The story begins in 1977 with a very young Pietro, the son of no one, growing up as an adoptive brother in a family in the poorest part of Secondigliano. A street kid, he scrapes by as best he can, dreaming of a well-being that is still denied him. The story unfolds through Pietro's loss of innocence, along with his brothers and lifelong friends, their ambitions, and his first great love, which, like that of every teenager, will be wild and passionate. His encounter with Angelo, known as 'A Sirena,' the regent of Secondigliano, marks his entry into the world of crime. Through violence, alliances, and betrayals, Pietro discovers the price that life takes.
The tragic death of a son in the remote town of Kuala Makar forces a father to track down suspicious individuals to find the real killer and clear his name.

Ten years after Goblin, Gong Yoo, Lee Dong-wook, Kim Go-eun, and Yoo In-na reunite for a special journey, revisiting iconic locations from the drama and sharing memories, stories, and reflections on one of Korea's most beloved series.
A renowned law professor and a team of students attempt to prove the innocence of a convicted man, but the brightest student is secretly connected to his past.

Every day, Belgian companies, government agencies, and ordinary citizens fall victim to cybercriminals. But how do they operate? And how easy is it really to break into something? Our tech journalist Kenneth Dée puts it to the test with a team of hackers for the new Streamz series ‘Hacked’.

Gu Yixiao, a ruthless business tycoon, seeks revenge on his secretary, Ye Xingwan, over a long-held misunderstanding, only to be drawn into a twisted love-hate relationship when she fights back. As past wounds resurface, both are forced to confront their emotions, leading to a path of redemption, though true peace remains uncertain.

After surviving her family's massacre as a child, a young woman assumes a new identity and spends years preparing for revenge. With an alliance of women at her side, she hunts down those responsible while searching for the mysterious figure behind the killings.

A lawyer named Yau Yam-yam finds herself in the underworld, where she is authorized by the King of Hell to become the "Underworld Advocate," traversing both realms to defend ghosts in court while simultaneously investigating her own murder.
A forbidden relationship shakes a powerful church family when it exposes infidelity and a mysterious murder, prompting a lawyer to uncover secrets buried between two families.

After discovering Hell University, a group of friends is forced into a lawless school where murder is allowed every night. As fear threatens to break them apart, Zein fights to keep her friends alive while uncovering a system designed to make no one leave.

From the fan-favorite series Homestead Rescue comes an all-new, high stakes intervention format with the Raney family. Wilderness living experts Marty and Matt, along with Misty Bilodeau, heed desperate pleas from concerned family, friends, or neighbors of homesteaders living beyond the edge of survival. Ambushed by an intervention, the stubborn off-gridders must decide whether to accept the rescue or stay on their dangerous path. For the first time, saving homesteads means confronting the people themselves.

Rookie office worker Wang Cuihua is suddenly pulled into the world of a novel, where she meets Xiahou Dan, a powerful king hiding his true identity. Both outsiders to this world, they join forces to survive a twisted fate, facing political intrigue, ancient prophecies, and life-or-death choices. As they fight to change their destiny, a powerful bond forms, one that could reshape the future of the kingdom.
Michael McWhorter, aka Tizzy Ent, searches for people who think they can do horrible things in public and get away with it.

On her wedding night, Crown Princess Gu Qingyao unexpectedly swaps souls with the assassin Shi Yi during an attempt on her husband’s life. Forced into a deadly game of deception and strategy, she fights to protect the crown prince while uncovering a far-reaching conspiracy that connects the imperial court with the martial world.
A death on live TV. A culprit who turns to gas. Behind it, a secret project that used and discarded the vulnerable. One detective pursues the dark truth.
Wrongfully imprisoned for murdering his own son, a father sets out on a desperate rescue mission after learning the boy may still be alive.
10-year-old Miguel stumbles upon a terrifying secret involving a boy trapped in a hole near his home.
A diverse group of tourists on an organized trip to Lisbon find themselves investigating a murder after one of them is killed on the first morning.

After a painful breakup at thirty, a woman’s life is thrown into turmoil when she reunites with a former illicit lover at her workplace, reigniting unresolved desire and drawing her back into a secret relationship where love and temptation blur.
A mysterious app promises wishes — then starts a countdown to death. As a group of teens becomes entangled, they must break the deadly chain to survive.
After a murder shatters the lives of three best friends, their decades-long bond is tested when an investigation reveals betrayals and shocking truths.

In a small 1980s town, two families face an unexpected child swap between Qi Shi, a courageous girl with albinism, and Cao Xin, a disciplined boy seen as perfect. As they navigate identity, family, and love, both children and parents confront personal and societal challenges. Together, they struggle through hardships to find happiness and belonging in a changing world.

Teaming up with a fresh crew of co-stars, Summer House's Amanda Batula, Kyle Cooke, and Lindsay Hubbard are set to bring the drama back to New York City as they navigate the biggest transitions of their lives at the time: marriage, separation, parenthood, reinvention, and the reality of growing up without growing apart.

Teams of expert storm chasers and certified weather spotters risk it all to venture into America's Tornado Alley. They self-shoot their encounters with nature at its most extreme, warn people in harm's way, and help save lives when disaster strikes.

Chan lives every day like it is summer vacation. Haran is trapped in a lonely winter. When their forgotten past reunites them, Chan is determined to gift her another spring. Through laughter and tears, they face winter together and reach their spring in this heartwarming romance.

Eight unique individuals all come together under the same roof with one shared dream: to master the art of acting. Over the course of an intense training camp, these aspiring actors must navigate four rigorous rounds of professional assessments, aiming to transform from novices into seasoned performers.

Rain-soaked night murder attempt unravels when father-daughter detectives Lao He and He Ying, grappling with impending retirement and fractured familial bonds, confront a case entangled with their past as suspects lead to the shadowy secrets of the Han Dong couple they once knew.
Four lifelong friends are caught in a web of blackmail when a leaked video threatens to expose the secrets that could destroy their friendship.

After witnessing her mother's suicide following a divorce, Xu Chi defies her tragic fate by rising from an ordinary graduate to a sharp-witted top consultant. Drawn into the covert revenge scheme of seasoned partner Ye Xinzhi, who mentors her while navigating their growing mutual attraction, the duo confronts a crossroads when professional upheavals collide with their evolving bond.

Set in the 1990s, in the ruthless port town of Isakapatnam, three forces collide—a woman driven by justice, a henchman torn by loyalty, and a common man hungry for revenge—each closing in on the empire built by the port’s most powerful man, Naidu.
Freshly divorced Lori and recently widowed minister Malcolm, friends with teens, navigate singlehood while questioning if their longstanding bond hints at a romantic future.

After losing her mother and her homeland, Sitara’s despair transforms into determination with the power of knowledge. New possibilities unfold when a family of scholars takes her in, deepening her education. Meanwhile, Genghis Khan’s Mongol Empire conquers nation after nation, nearing Sitara’s new home. After the Fourth Prince of the empire takes her captive, a flame of revenge is ignited.
The guest is king — but so is the host! Yu Jae-seok opens his first B&B, where he runs things his way and treats guests to his signature games.

Set in Vaikuntapuram, a sacred temple town nestled between the banks of the Godavari and the neon lights of pop stardom, a disciplined heir to a musical throne and a fame-weary singer strike a forbidden chord. To protect a century of heritage, they must navigate a landscape of family secrets, masked identities, and the heavy price of finding their own voices.

Thirty years after his landmark debut album, artist, icon, philanthropist, and entrepreneur JAŸ-Z sits down with longtime friend, producer, and director Rick Rubin for an intimate reflection on his storied career.

A thrice-widowed woman marries Ye Lang, the illegitimate son of a powerful tycoon, believing she’s found a sincere younger lover—only to be drawn into a hidden scheme. Reborn after dying on his wedding day in a past life, Ye Lang returns seeking revenge, but finds himself entangled in her charm once again. As love and suspicion collide, deeper secrets surface, revealing that someone else may be manipulating everything from behind the scenes.

The evil general forcefully marries the money-grubbing fake heiress who is obsessed with mechanical arts. From a contractual couple to exposing each other's true identities in a life-and-death situation, their mutual love and hatred intensify. They uncover court conspiracies, shatter deadly chaos, and safeguard the peace of the nation.
Across seven Asian cities, strangers are forced into a deadly game where only one can save their loved one by beating the others.

Jackie Price has been living a wealthy, luxurious life for the past 20 years after escaping a dangerous past as an international cocaine dealer. But just as life begins to feel a little boring, she discovers that The Seven Demons, a group of the world’s most terrifying hitmen, have been hired to kill her.

A spirited young villager and her reluctant ally race against a seven-day demolition deadline, battling viral mishaps, copyright disputes, and a rival village’s sabotage to save their coastal hometown—and find love along the way.
A group of Filipino and Korean stars comes together to operate a Filipino pop-up restaurant in Seoul.

A look at the life of Australian pop star Kylie Minogue, who opens her personal archives and reflects on a career in which she has sold 80 million records and reinvented herself, and by extension pop, several times. Home movies, personal photographs and new interviews reveal the picture, as Kylie addresses how she’s faced public scrutiny, personal loss and illness.

When 200-year-old human remains discovered in the Himalayas are identified as a perfect DNA match to a missing woman, a complex mystery involving suspicious deaths, lost memories, and hidden truths begins to unfold.
Two intergalactic cops, new recruit John Stewart and Lantern legend Hal Jordan, are drawn into a dark, Earth-based mystery as they investigate a murder in the American heartland.
When emergency dispatcher Ian Ridley receives a frantic call from a teenager he believes could be his long-missing daughter, he stops at nothing to find her.
The Straw Hats hit the high seas in a two-part LEGO special! Join Luffy, Nami, Usopp and the crew on their epic journey, fully reimagined brick by brick.

At 27, Himari Shibasaki and Kazumi Hojo have been inseparable since college, but a drunken confession about Himari’s romantic insecurities completely transforms the boundaries of their friendship. What begins as a physical arrangement born from mutual loneliness quickly evolves into more, as neither of them is sure if their romantic feelings are reciprocated. Kazumi, haunted by a traumatic childhood, has secretly loved Himari, who he believes saved him from his own hollowness. Meanwhile, Himari struggles to drop the "perfect girl" persona she uses to mask her own past grief. As they navigate the transition from friends-with-benefits to a committed couple, their fragile peace is threatened by a jealous coworker and a dangerous stalker from Himari’s past, leading to a potentially dangerous situation.
An improvised, comedic approach to major events in American history in celebration of the 250th anniversary of the founding of the United States.
Brilliant but controversial, lawyer Lorenzo Ligas fights for Milan's desperate cases alongside idealistic intern Marta, seeking justice and confronting his own shortcomings.

In the coastal town of Fogang, a family's life within the state oil corporation collapses after a gas explosion in 1997, leading the son Chen Shan to unearth factional conspiracies behind the tragedy through a new blast in 2001.

In 1997, a disappearance inside an elevator pulls detectives He Yuanhang and Ran Fangxu into a twisted mystery. Facing doubt and confusion along the way, they press on to uncover the truth. As time moves on, they heal from life's uncertainties, hold fast to justice, and rise above hardship with resilience and hope.

A family of law enforcement agents bridges personal differences and crosses professional boundaries as they tackle cases for the FBI, US Marshals, Secret Service and Department of Justice. After a seemingly cut-and-dry case turns into a deadly conspiracy, they must use the expertise from a lifetime of protecting civilians and politicians to protect one another and bring the killer to justice … even if it means betraying their sworn code.
The extraordinary true story of lion cub Kio, on his journey to become a king.

Ning Changyue and Song Yiqiu share a deep, timeless connection that spans three thousand years. In the present day, their journey to understand love, belonging, and eternity is complicated by the resurfacing of a long-buried past and unresolved fates. Facing the echoes of history and the trials of the modern world, they must make pivotal choices that define their love and ultimate home.

In 1990s Beijing, a small inn bears witness to the lives of a group of young men and women who have come from all corners of the country, to chase their dreams in the city. Xu Shengli, obsessed with scriptwriting, never gives up despite constant rejection. Singer Zhuang Zhuang, yearning to perform on prestigious stages, can only make a living through commercial gigs. Shen Ranran, hoping to play leading roles, faces opportunities and tough choices in the flashy entertainment industry. Talented cellist Tao Liangliang plays under overpasses, pursuing his musical dreams. Guo Zongbao, a background actor and an artist at heart, juggles odd jobs in order to treat his wife and children's illnesses. Painter Cao Ye struggles in a world that does not understand him. They work tirelessly for their dreams, yet reality is always cruel and unyielding. As the new millennium arrives, some continue to persevere while others are forced to give up, but the flame of art never dies in their hearts.

A group of young people who survived life-threatening health struggles moves into a house together to find true love. Having faced life's fragility firsthand, they look past the superficial to build deep, intense, and meaningful connections—without wasting a single second.

Xiao Zhiyu and Hu Xiu are brought together by a Republic of China-themed murder mystery game. In the scripted NPC game filled with falling snow and spies in the shadows, the two ignite a fateful spark. An unexpected reunion in the real world reveals the mystery of each other's identities. The two shuttle between the misaligned time-spaces of reality and the script, and finally achieve two-way growth in the cross-dimensional bond, completing the transformation of love and self.

The exceptionally gifted Ghost King, He Simu, unexpectedly encounters the young general, Duan Xu, while out on a break, searching for food. This young general, who carries an item belonging to someone from He Simu's past, seems not to be the real Duan Xu. As they test each other through subtle exchanges, He Simu gradually uncovers the dark past and aspirations hidden within Duan Xu’s heart. In turn, Duan Xu discovers the steadfastness and loneliness that He Simu has endured. Despite the fleeting lifespan of a mortal, no more than a hundred years, and the four-hundred-year-old ghost who still retains the appearance of a young girl, they resist the relentless passage of time through their love.

In the 1990s, teenagers Chen Yi and Miao Jing met due to their parents, initially getting off to a rocky start. However, Miao Jing's kindness eventually softens Chen Yi's attitude towards her. Chen Yi and Miao Jing's relationship deepens after Chen Yi's father dies and Miao Jing's mother disappears, leaving the two to rely only on each other. Miao Jing eventually confesses her feelings for Chen Yi, but he pushes her away after he gets tangled up as a crime witness, urging her to leave their city. Years later, Chen Yi runs a billiards hall in their hometown, while Miao Jing returns for a work assignment. But when Chen Yi suspects that Miao Jing's boss is involved in smuggling, he vows to protect her – and stay by her side.

Qian Fei, an employee in a bank, was planning a fulfilling life. But after being abandoned by her fiancé, she had to redefine her life. Li Yifei, from a rich family, always prioritized his career. His girlfriend couldn't endure poverty and left. To cover her mortgage, Fei rent out a room to Yifei, and they became collaborators. Fei bravely faced challenges and grew through the process. Their journey was marked by collisions, but they fell in love and decided to face the future together.

Taekang Group's successor, Yoon Yi-jun, is the prime suspect of a shocking murder. To uncover the truth, Kang Jae-hee goes undercover as a male secretary to keep an eye on Yi-jun. The closer they get to what really happened, the closer Yi-jun and Jae-hee become. Will Jae-hee, who is hiding her identity, and Yi-jun, who is hiding a secret, be able to let their true feelings be known to one another?

A former top actress who has lost her ability to feel and a psychological counselor who feels too much are brought together through a mysterious ability to share emotions. As she begins to rediscover emotions through him, and he learns to manage the overwhelming weight of empathy through her, the two gradually heal each other in unexpected ways.

Celebrating the 10th anniversary of Love in the Moonlight, the cast reunites for a special variety show filled with laughter, memories, behind-the-scenes stories, and heartfelt moments. A nostalgic reunion brings the beloved stars back together to revisit the drama that captured hearts a decade ago.
A cheerful side dish shop owner and a chef hiding a secret cross paths at a local market, but their path to romance won't be easy.
A VR dating CEO who hates love meets a romance-clueless writer. As they clash between AI-driven passion and analog emotions, a sweet yet messy story of healing and unexpected connection unfolds.
An anthology of sweeping true love stories that captured the world’s attention.
Heartbroken Estong meets the mysterious Ysa, who has Dissociative Identity Disorder (DID), and learns that love comes with not one twist, but lots of it.

Forced to take on the role of a villain, a once-good man watches his loved ones betray him and his promising future collapse into a living nightmare. Driven by injustice, he sets out to confront those responsible and reclaim what was taken—no matter the cost.

"Goodbye" is something that could happen to anyone tomorrow. And the feelings that remain afterwards. Through the serious subject of "forensic medicine," it carefully captures the feelings of love for others and the time they lived, quietly shedding light on the darkness of a "society where the cause of death is unknown".

Jiang Jiaqi, nearing forty, struggles with a failing marriage and workplace oppression. His life becomes more complicated when he is implicated in a bribery case with his subordinate, Liang Zhi'an, a twenty-year-old woman burdened by her parents' death and caring for her paralyzed grandmother. Despite their different lives, Liang’s presence reignites Jiang's spirit, and as they connect with supportive figures around them, they find warmth, encouragement, and healing in each other amidst their struggles.
When a multi-million-dollar heist goes sideways, con artist Lucky is forced to go on the run. Pursued by both the FBI and a ruthless crime boss, Lucky must fight for her life—and a way out.
A young sportsman infiltrates the wild and dangerous world of Punjab's rap music to investigate a drug syndicate, only to find himself torn between love, family, guilt and brotherhood.
A debt-ridden building owner agrees to stage a fake kidnapping to save his family and property, only for the plan to spiral into a real abduction and a dangerously escalating situation.

Get ready, Australia! The nation's biggest obsession just got a whole lot juicier. The Married At First Sight universe is expanding like never before with the launch of MAFS: After The Dinner Party, your first and only place to dive into exclusive, unfiltered interviews with the participants right after the show's iconic dinner parties. Plus, fans will have the chance to see unseen footage that picks up right where the main show leaves off, offering even more drama and insight.

With Jules Lund, Brittany Hockley, and Laura Byrne steering the conversation, the debrief starts the second the dinner party ends. MAFS: After The Dinner Party is the ultimate companion series, offering an unapologetic look at the season's biggest scandals. Whether it’s the 'red flags' or catching a first glimpse of the wreckage, this is the essential, no-holds-barred breakdown where the tea is spilt, and the real truth is revealed.
A marketer with traditional views on love and marriage tries to navigate a connection with an adult toy company CEO with different values.

College student Kong Xiaocan discovers that his mother, Kong Guifang, is terminally ill. Through a "life energy" exchange, she regains her youthful appearance at 20 and begins a new chapter in her life, alongside her son and young friends.
When Luang Pho and the gang become suspects in a diamond robbery case, an action-filled mission to restore their honour begins.
Haunted by his past and hunted by his enemies, a Special Forces veteran fights to keep a teenage girl alive on the deadly streets of Rio de Janeiro.

Returning to England, Susan Ryeland is reluctantly drawn into a new Atticus Pünd mystery, this time written by a new, young writer. 'Pünd’s Last Case" is a story set in 1955, in an exotic villa in Corfu – but the identity of a real killer is hidden in the text, and once again Susan is going to find herself in grave danger.

The daughter of a former Hooter's waitress and an ex-pro wrestler, Margo is a recent college dropout and aspiring writer. Faced with a new baby, mounting pile of bills, and dwindling number of ways to pay them, Margo must find a way forward.

With the Yellowstone Ranch behind him, Kayce Dutton joins an elite unit of U.S. Marshals, combining his skills as a cowboy and Navy SEAL to bring range justice to Montana, where he and his teammates must balance family, duty and the high psychological cost that comes with serving as the last line of defense in the region's war on violence.
A cast of bears, raccoons, deer, foxes and a host of other horny, lovable forest critters navigate love, sexual relationships and the universal need to hook up and find a partner.
A newly divorced mom falls down a dangerous rabbit hole of blackmail, murder, and youth soccer.

When human remains from an old case are unearthed, a forensic pathologist mysteriously makes contact with his father thirty years in the past. Their connection draws them into a series of murders, forcing them to work across time to uncover a buried truth.

Angelo Doyle lives two totally separate lives — fearsome NYC hitman and sleepy upstate Cooperstown photocopier salesman and father. Both of them are threatened when he is diagnosed with Alzheimer's, a disease he already lost his older brother to.

When star Korean spatial designer Lee Yubin loses everything, he heads off to a Japanese island. There, he meets Karin, a resilient strawberry farmer. Hailing from different worlds, their lives collide in a big misunderstanding. Buckle up for "Merry Berry Love," a sweet and sour Korea-Japan rom-com.

After a forbidden act to save the fairy Yuyao, heavenly official Lu Siyuan is condemned to repeated reincarnations, binding their fates across lifetimes. Drawn back together again and again, they face a vengeful force in Xuan Qing and the consequences of defying heaven while protecting a powerful relic tied to their past.
In this crime thriller, Detective Chen Chia-jen races to unmask Baba the Witch, the viral tarot reader who accurately predicts the deaths of influencers.
At Minerva Military High School, teens navigate discipline, rivalry and family pressure as a young cadet searches for answers about his missing friend.
Corinne runs Chénoise prison with her unlikely team: By-the-book Jeff, JP who's always been closer to inmates than colleagues, and rookie Stéphanie.
Two women from seemingly-opposite backgrounds both navigate the difficulties of mothering adult children.

Explore the greatest machines, most impactful weapons, and groundbreaking innovations of WWII, shining a light on the engineering and technological advances that shaped the course of the conflict and continue to influence our world today.

A disillusioned billionaire heir Trai abandons his fortune and hides among ordinary people, where he falls for Phakbung, a day laborer who believes money is everything. As love deepens, Trai must confront his fear that wealth will once again come before true love.

Filmmaker Eric Goode follows his first love — reptiles — into the dark underworld of exotic animal smuggling. In this billion-dollar global network, everyone is chasing the ultimate prize, whether it be owning the rarest of species, claiming the biggest fortunes, or taking down the most elusive criminals. As he digs deeper, Goode uncovers a labyrinth of outlaw traffickers, bombastic collectors, and the dogged law enforcement agents on their tails.
The story of Piotr Leyer, a lawyer who, through a tragic twist of fate, becomes the head of a criminal gang.
This trophy-packed, insider-fuelled documentary charts José Mourinho's iconic rise as one of the world's top footballing managers of the most elite clubs.
A reclusive writer wakes to find his identity stolen — and must ally with a ruthless loan shark to reclaim his life from a man known as "The Rat."
When a comic becomes the inspiration for a killer, the author is forced to work with a detective to try and uncover the truth.

A young woman destined to suffer as a tribal spirit medium is rescued by a city outsider who falls in love with her. But after tragedy strikes, she returns as a vengeful spirit seeking justice against those who abused her.
In 1970s Istanbul, a man's forbidden love for a shop-girl evolves into a lifelong journey of obsession and longing.

A dedicated fangirl lands a job at a fashion company, only to discover it was co-founded by her ultimate idol. Determined to remain professional, she hides her identity, but is quickly thrown off course by the company's workaholic CEO. As secret unrequited feelings and hidden personal struggles entangle the trio, she finds herself torn between her lifelong obsession and an unexpected new connection.
Restless, razor-sharp and refusing to conform, 17-year-old Sybylla Melvyn is dead set on writing her own story in an era that expects her to find a man and settle down.
Join the sweet and naïve Aemie as she navigates married life with mafia boss husband Zeke, and the dangerous world she’s about to enter.
After accidentally freeing a Dragon Lord from the Dragon Abyss, a sacrificed general's daughter allies with him to fight political conspiracies.
Deputy Commissioner Gutierrez competes with the CIA to solve the murder of the Russian Ambassador with his unique style.

A laugh-a-minute romantic comedy where a 2025 feelings coach gets zapped into a cheesy vintage novel and meets her match, a 1999 CEO who's sweet on the outside but shrewd within. In the ultimate battle of romantic tactics, who will out-scheme whom? To get home, influencer Lin Huan'er launches an operation to win over CEO Gao Haiming, only for her clever plans to hilariously backfire. Just as her ticket home appears, she realizes her heart has already checked in for good. Can this cross-storybook couple write their own happy ending?
A Joseon-era villain doomed to die opens her eyes in modern-day Seoul — where a ruthless chaebol heir may be her last chance to rewrite her fate.
A reclusive doctor with supernatural abilities faces a disruption when her young niece visits, bringing a different and more intense approach to their shared gift of communicating with spirits.
When fame becomes a burden and criticism leaves wounds, crossing paths with this tutoring guy… will it be a lesson, or a test of the heart?
A school teacher with dreams of becoming a professional gamer is forced to marry her childhood first love, whose hatred of video games puts their relationship to the test.

A descendant of a legendary tomb-raiding family infiltrates four powerful clans before returning to a mysterious tomb from 20 years earlier, where deadly traps and supernatural horrors reveal a long-hidden truth.

For the first time ever, 12 Naked and Afraid All-Stars are going overboard. They've been told it's a Lost Coast challenge in the South Pacific, but they're about to be shipwrecked in the dark of night instead. The All-Stars will have to survive for 35 days -- and then rescue themselves to go home.

Special Agent Sam Hanna returns to his hometown of New York City to the NCIS field office and partners with a roguish agent, Nick Schaeffer, to help lead a new team as they are tasked with high-stakes missions to defend one of the most vital cities and ports in the world.

Frances Neagley is a private investigator in Chicago and former military colleague of Jack Reacher in the Army's 110th Special Investigations Unit. When she learns that a beloved friend from her past has been killed in a suspicious accident, she becomes hell-bent on justice.

Examines stories of absurd, outrageous, and dramatic real-life residential conflicts from a wide range of larger-than-life characters across the United States, opening a verité portal into the lives of contemporary American.

To save her gravely ill grandmother, top student Zhou Wan approaches her mother's stepson, Lu Xixiao, for funds. They fall for each other over the summer after graduation but are torn apart by misunderstandings in reality. Ten years later, they reunite at work. Though Lu Xixiao harbors resentment, his love for Zhou Wan remains. As they uncover the truth behind a "factory accident," they resolve their differences and reunite.

Pei Qian accidentally gets an invitation from a mysterious big brother to start a company that must aim to lose money, and eventually becomes a conscientious boss in the hearts of his employees and an industry-recognized business whiz!
Imbued with the power to grant wishes, a cynical nine-tailed fox's life takes a turn when she encounters a soccer player — altering both of their fates.

After a mystical reversal turns the divine stone spirit Shangguan Ziyan into a man, he joins the disciplined Daoist Yuan Chu in the Yuan Zhen Sect. Appointed as demon hunters, the two embark on a mission to seal monsters and restore the heavens—only to uncover each other’s hidden secrets along the way.
After 26 years of tournament drought, Norway's 2026 World Cup hopes were next to nil. But what followed rekindled belief.
Follow five work-obsessed twenty-somethings striving for professional success and, if they have time, personal happiness in Manhattan's most glamorous neighborhood, Murray Hill.
A literature professor discovers a student's talent and offers him writing lessons — but as he sinks into the story, their sessions spiral into chaos.

Oasis is the most luxurious holiday resort in the country — a paradise reserved for the wealthiest families, featuring private beaches, VIP facilities, and impenetrable security. The perfect place to spend the best summer of your life. But everything falls apart when the police storm the resort to investigate a mysterious disappearance. In such an exclusive place, everyone is a suspect — and no one can leave until the culprit is found.

Hannah Wells tutors hockey captain Garrett Graham to win over her crush. Their deal becomes real connection as they face their pasts. Friends Logan, Dean, Tucker, and Allie navigate college life and love.
A wildly unpredictable romance begins when a flawed “master of melodrama” actor encounters a mysterious woman who believes she is the female lead of a TV drama.

A decade after O.J. Simpson was controversially acquitted of the murders of his ex-wife Nicole Brown Simpson and her friend Ron Goldman, he attempted to rebrand himself as a reality TV star with the hidden camera prank PPV special Juiced.

After seven years of marriage, a couple decides to call it quits—but their “perfect breakup” quickly turns into a messy battle of pride, jealousy, and unresolved feelings. As unexpected twists pull them back together, they must confront the love they thought was long gone. Can they truly walk away from each other?

In 1995, Zhao Fengsheng returns home only to be shunned by villagers, prompting him to lead the “Four Troublemakers of Old Street” in uncovering a dark conspiracy, settling old feuds, and restoring peace to their town.

One map brought to life by excitement, adventure, and 'challenges' !

Travel the world by following the 'Challenge Map', take on hidden missions across the globe, and prove each group's strengths and unique charm.
Orphan Xiong Yuanbao and his neighbor Mu Qingyun grow up side by side, supporting each other through life’s hardships as their deep bond and shared dreams are tested in a changing era.

Free-spirited commoner Lina unexpectedly becomes a candidate to wed the cold and duty-bound Prince Kiran, but as she navigates palace rivalries and political intrigue, she discovers she may be the key to exposing a rebellion—and the consort destined for him all along.
Follows a controversial undercover operation that sent Alain Olivier, a drug-addicted Quebec forestry student, to death row in Thailand in 1989.

In the 1990s, orphan Zhang Xiaoman grows up in the industrial city of Tiexicheng, earning the title “Son of Tiexicheng” for his loyalty and integrity. Alongside the steady Xia Lei and the brave Yan Xiaodan, he experiences a passionate youth. As economic changes force them to leave their hometown to search for new opportunities, they eventually return, weaving a touching story of unwavering loyalty and finding their way back home.
An ambitious prosecutor loses her memory and moves in with a boxing coach who claims to be her boyfriend. Can this sticky situation turn into real love?
Two in-laws forced to raise their orphaned nephew together slowly overcome their misunderstandings, finding personal growth and an unexpected romance through co-parenting under one roof.
On a remote tropical island, 16 players must survive the elements, outmaneuver rivals and remain part of a team for a chance to win a $1 million prize.

In Republican Shanghai, Murong Qingyi, a warlord’s son swapped at birth, endures years of torment. His life changes when Ren Susu saves him, but tragedy strikes her family because of it. Years later, love sparks between them, but Ren Susu fakes her death to save another, leaving Qingyi heartbroken. Three years on, she returns as his future sister-in-law. Love, hate, betrayal, and old wounds resurface. As war looms, the two must defy fate together, but can love survive a nation’s fall?
After losing his wife and daughter in a terrorist attack, an elite bodyguard goes into hiding and forms a private security team overseas to protect Chinese citizens living abroad.

A woman wrongfully believed to be dead returns with her child, while another woman assumes her twin sister’s identity to seek revenge. Years later, a woman who looks identical to a murdered daughter appears and abandons her own identity to avenge her father. As both women sacrifice their identities for revenge, what fate awaits them?

In 21st-century Korea under a constitutional monarchy, a chaebol heiress with everything but status tries to take control of her future after crossing paths with a lonely prince with nothing but his title. Together, bound by a contract marriage, they begin a class-defying romance to rewrite destiny.
A timid lawyer who suddenly gains the ability to see ghosts teams up with a cold, elite attorney, and together they take on supernatural clients whose unfinished business reveals buried truths.
After waking up from a freak car accident, Sonny discovers that his mother has been replaced by an impostor.
One hundred Italian athletes face brutal physical challenges, each battling to outlast the rest and claim the glory of becoming the one true champion.
Reality competition show based on the original Korean format.
A continuation of the *Śleboda* series, centering on anthropologist Anka Serafin and journalist Sebastian Strzygoń. This time, the story takes us to Upper Silesia.
When a gifted ER surgeon is thrust into cosmetic medicine, her clash with a celebrity doctor exposes the greed and desire beneath the glamour.
In 1977 Moscow, two "PONIES" ("persons of no interest") become CIA operatives and uncover a Cold War conspiracy their husbands were killed for.
A man and a woman who swore off marriage find their carefully controlled lives overturned after a one-night mistake forces them into an unexpected, reverse romance neither planned nor wanted.

After returning home to revive her mother’s failing restaurant, Ren Xizhou reunites with her estranged high school classmate Xiang Nanfeng. As they work together to save the restaurant and confront their past misunderstandings, they heal old wounds and find the courage to embrace a new beginning.

After losing an important memory before ascending to immortality, Bai Suzhen descends to the mortal world with Xiao Qing to find Xu Xian and repay a past kindness. Along the way, they become entangled with demon hunter Xu Xian and Fa Hai, setting the four on a fateful journey.
